strategies.name: Baseline Sequential All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Execute 8 sequential all-reduce operations with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling and uncoupling transformations. 8 all-reduce dispatches, each blocking on full (world_size*2048) tensor. Straightforward translation of the problem statement with no optimization—maximizes latency due to serialized collectives but simplest to verify correctness.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Decompose each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, enabling 16 total collectives but with smaller per-rank payloads (2048 elements during reduce-scatter). Apply bidiagonal transformations on local shards between reduce-scatter and all-gather. Trades dispatch count for reduced bandwidth per operation and potential overlap opportunities.

strategies.name: Fused Bidiagonal Transformation Batching
strategies.desc: Precompute multiple bidiagonal coupling matrices and batch the local transformations, then issue all-reduces in bursts. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reorganizes local compute to enable better memory access patterns and potential vectorization. Same communication volume but improved compute-communication interleaving.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology (assuming nodes with multiple devices) by performing intra-node reductions first, applying bidiagonal transforms at node granularity, then inter-node collectives. Requires careful rank-to-node mapping but reduces cross-node traffic from 8 full all-reduces to potentially 8*(intra-node + inter-node) collectives with smaller payloads on the expensive inter-node links.

strategies.name: Pipelined Ring-Based Custom Collective
strategies.desc:
Replace monolithic all-reduce with custom ring-based reduce-scatter-allgather pattern that pipelines chunks of the tensor, applying bidiagonal coupling incrementally as chunks arrive. Approximately 8*2*world_size point-to-point-equivalent operations but with fine-grained pipelining. Hides latency through overlap at cost of algorithmic complexity and potentially more kernel launches.
